name: hitl-escalate-1.0.0
description: Human-in-the-Loop escalation — SMS and voice call when Zeus hasn't responded to a critical HITL request on Discord/Telegram

tools.name: hitl_escalate_sms
tools.description: Send an urgent SMS to Zeus when he hasn't responded to a HITL approval request on Discord/Telegram within the expected window. Use after 5–15 minutes of no response on high-priority items.

decision.description: One sentence describing what decision is pending (e.g. 'Approve $500 server upgrade')

context.description: Why this matters or what happens if not addressed (e.g. 'Server goes down at midnight without renewal')

options.description: Optional: what responses are valid (e.g. 'Reply YES to approve or NO to cancel')

tools.name: hitl_escalate_voice
tools.description: Initiate a voice call to Zeus as the final escalation step. Use ONLY when Zeus has not responded to Discord messages AND an SMS escalation within a critical timeout window (30+ minutes). This is the last resort for L0/L1 decisions.

decision.description: One sentence describing the pending decision (spoken aloud in the call)
